login.operator: Sign in as the operator with a password

admin.passwordHint: Off: only the providers let people in. You as the operator can always use your password.
admin.addressHint: The address people use to reach {{app}}. Invitations, providers and links in mails use it.
admin.addressChangeConfirm: authentik still knows the redirect address {{address}}. After saving, sign-in through authentik works again only once you run the button under “authentik in one step” again.
admin.addressChangeHand_one: For {{count}} provider entered by hand, change the redirect address there yourself.
admin.addressChangeHand_other: For {{count}} providers entered by hand, change the redirect address there yourself.
admin.providersText: Any provider that speaks OpenID Connect: authentik, Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, Authelia, Pocket ID. Each gets a button on the sign-in page.
admin.empty: No provider yet. Set up authentik below in one step or add a provider by hand.
admin.removeConfirm_one: Remove “{{name}}”? {{count}} account loses the link; for {{only}} of them it is the only way in.
admin.removeConfirm_other: Remove “{{name}}”? {{count}} accounts lose the link; for {{only}} of them it is the only way in.
admin.label: Name on the button
admin.slugHint: Part of the redirect address; it cannot be changed later.
admin.issuerHint: authentik: https://auth.example.com/application/o/{{slug}}/. Microsoft Entra ID: https://login.microsoftonline.com/TENANT-ID/v2.0, or common or organizations for several tenants. Entra takes only https redirect addresses (localhost aside) and sends the email address only as the optional claim email.
admin.secretKept: stored, leave empty to keep it
admin.autoCreateHint: Off: only invited people and linked accounts come in through this provider. On: whoever has an account there gets one here as a member.
admin.trustsSecondFactor: The provider checks the second factor itself
admin.trustsSecondFactorHint: Off: whoever has a second factor here is asked for the code after signing in through the provider.
admin.issuerChangeConfirm_one: Another issuer is another provider. {{count}} account will have to link again afterwards.
admin.issuerChangeConfirm_other: Another issuer is another provider. {{count}} accounts will have to link again afterwards.

authentik.title: authentik in one step
authentik.text: With an API token that may create applications, {{app}} sets up provider and application in authentik itself. The token is used for that only and never stored.
authentik.asking: One moment, authentik is being asked. This can take up to 20 seconds.
authentik.noAddress: No public address yet. You reach {{app}} at this address right now, and authentik leads back to it after sign-in:
authentik.proxyWarning: The server receives this request as {{address}}. If {{app}} runs behind a proxy, the proxy has to pass on the scheme (X-Forwarded-Proto) and {{app}} has to trust it (the setting for trusted proxies, see the documentation).
authentik.stale: authentik still knows the old redirect address {{address}}. Sign-in through authentik does not work until you run the button again with a token.

why.unreachable: authentik cannot be reached at this address. Check the address and whether {{app}} reaches that network.
why.unusable: This address cannot be used. Check how it is written.
why.token: authentik did not accept the token (answer {{status}}). Check that it is valid and has the rights it needs.
why.malformed: The token contains characters no token has. Copy it from authentik once more.
why.answered: Something answers at this address, but not authentik as expected (answer {{status}}). Check the address; the whole answer is in the log.
why.slug: Every slug {{app}} would give its application already belongs to another application in authentik. Rename the {{app}} provider there and try again.
why.coupled: While {{app}} is coupled, sign-in comes through the coupling. Uncouple first, then set up authentik here.
why.issuer_change_one: This is another authentik than before, so another issuer. {{count}} account will have to link again afterwards.
why.issuer_change_other: This is another authentik than before, so another issuer. {{count}} accounts will have to link again afterwards.
why.public_url_needed: {{app}} has no public address yet. Use the suggested one, and {{app}} sets up authentik with it.

account.title: Sign-in providers
account.text: Link your account to a provider, then you can sign in there too. Your password confirms it is you.
account.only: This account signs in through {{name}} only.

error.oidc_not_configured: This provider is not set up.
error.oidc_provider_unreachable: The provider cannot be reached right now.
error.oidc_provider_invalid: The provider's answer cannot be understood.
error.oidc_issuer_mismatch: The provider calls itself something other than what was entered.
error.oidc_state_mismatch: The sign-in ran out or came from elsewhere. Try again.
error.oidc_token_refused: The provider did not redeem the code.
error.oidc_token_invalid: The provider's answer was not valid.
error.oidc_no_signing_key: The provider signs without a key. Choose a signing key for the provider there.
error.oidc_no_account: There is no account for you here. Ask for an invitation, or sign in with your password and link your account in your account settings.
error.oidc_subject_taken: This identity is linked to another account already.
error.oidc_only_account: This account signs in through this provider only. The last link stays.
error.oidc_link_mismatch: This link belongs to another account.
error.invite_invalid: The invitation ran out or has been used.
error.account_blocked: This account is blocked. Ask the operator.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

formError.slug_invalid: The short name takes a to z, digits and dashes, up to 40 characters.
formError.slug_taken: Another entry has this short name already.
formError.label_required: Enter a name for the button.
formError.issuer_invalid: The issuer must start with http:// or https://.
formError.client_secret_invalid: The client secret is too long.
formError.provider_managed: This provider comes through a coupling and changes only there.
